condition: dig_threshold_desc:I usually looked out for the number 20. If the gems per dig got close to 20 or I believed it would drop below 20 on the next dig I would try for another planet.
planet: surprise_desc:If the number of gems dropped a lot between the first and second dig I would be more likely to leave and try a new planet.
n_prac_rounds: dynamic_desc:If the difference between digs was low I was more likely to stay digging on that planet. If the difference between the first and second dig was large I left the planet sooner.
aliens: feedback:Everything made sense to me and seemed to work great! Thanks so much!!}
